catalysts.headline: Withdrew bank regulatory applications (OCC and Federal Reserve) to acquire Grasshopper Bancorp, ending the planned bank-charter acquisition; CEO Steve Cunningham cited the absence of clear regulatory standards for nonbanks seeking bank charters and said the process is susceptible to political pressure and outside advocacy; company maintained its application met statutory approval criteria; reaffirmed Q3 and full-year 2026 guidance in the same disclosure. Shares fell sharply same day (one source cites -23.43%).
catalysts.impact: Stock reportedly fell more than 20% intraday (one source: -23.43%)
catalysts.note: Deal had merger agreement with a reported $5M termination fee payable by Enova in certain circumstances; only the regulatory applications were withdrawn, not a formal termination announced in sources found. A plaintiff-side law firm (Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz) separately announced an investigation into Enova for possible securities-law violations following the stock drop -- this is a solicitation of potential claimants, not a regulatory or judicial finding.

catalysts.headline: Withdrew its OCC and Federal Reserve regulatory applications for its proposed ~$369M acquisition of Grasshopper Bancorp/Bank, effectively ending the deal; reaffirmed FY2026 guidance and said it would accelerate share buybacks
